## What's included in v1.3.7

### Supplier & customer opening balance fix
- Opening balance is now fixed history: receipts/payments no longer reduce it. The full amount posts to the customer credit / supplier balance delta, so the ledger closing balance and the list balance always agree.
- Editing or deleting a receipt/payment reverses the full amount from the delta column.
- One-time repair migration (`party_balance_fix_v1`) restores opening balances consumed by older builds and recovers overpayments whose remainder was previously dropped. Runs automatically once on first launch.
- Customer Edit modal now prefills Opening Balance from `opening_balance` only (not the credit delta), so saving cannot overwrite it.
- Advances/overpayments now show as a negative party balance instead of disappearing.

### Shared numeric input grouping engine (`static/calc.js`)
- Every money and quantity input now uses `type="text" inputmode="decimal"` with `data-num="money"` / `data-num="qty"`.
- Calculator-style live thousands grouping while typing (e.g. `600000` shows as `600,000`), 2-decimal normalization for money, quantity precision preserved.
- Paste sanitizing (`Rs 1,234.56` → `1234.56`) and arithmetic expressions on Enter/blur (`500+50`, `=500+50`).
- `min`/`max` clamping on blur; dynamically rendered rows (invoice lines, BOM, POS cart) attach automatically via `MutationObserver`.
- Reading `el.value` still returns the comma-free raw value, so existing handlers and JSON payloads are unchanged.
- Shared `toNumber()` / `parseNum()` helpers replace fragile single-comma stripping when reading displayed text (e.g. Summary totals).
- Applied across inventory, POS, sales/purchase invoices and returns, BOM, production orders, recipe profiles, raw materials, stock adjustments/transfers, payroll, expenses, payments, receipts, accounts, customers and suppliers.
